Doc’s Seafood Shack is where Gulf Coast Alabama locals go for fresh seafood and Doc’s famous fried shrimp. Come visit our Orange Beach Seafood Restaurant!
Ask anyone on the island. For 34 years, we’ve been welcoming visitors from all across the country. We’re not fancy, but that’s part of our charm! Come enjoy some of the best Orange Beach seafood.
Doc and his staff are always cookin’ up boatloads of fresh seafood and their world famous fried shrimp (you’ve just gotta try them!), and “you” can “build-your-own” delicious seafood platter. They’re also known to cook up a mess of famous fried fish and a big pot of the best seafood gumbo ever! Check out our seafood menu and allow us to tantalize your taste buds with a taste of the Gulf Coast. If you’re looking to treat your family to a seafood feast, your happiness is our specialty.
Plus, Doc’s big on lunch specials, raw oysters, chicken fingers, onion rings, cold draft beer and big ol’ deep water royal red shrimp. Put on your flip-flops, grab the kids and come see us…Doc’ll be waiting! Open 11am daily!

If you are really hungry, try Doc’s “Create Your Own” Seafood Platter. You can choose from several seafood selections and have it fried or grilled.
Healthy Seafood
For the more health conscious, try Doc’s specialty Baked Seafood Platter. Doc’s Seafood Shack serves some of the tastiest seafood dishes on the Gulf Coast and there is something for everyone… even a great Hamburger, amazing Fried Chicken, and homemade Onion Rings.

If you and your family are looking for one of the best Gulf Shores seafood restaurants or Orange Beach Seafood restaurant… come on down to Doc’s Seafood Shack & Oyster Bar, and don’t forget your flip-flops.

 Welcome to our Orange Beach AL Seafood Restaurant – Doc’s Seafood Shack & Oyster Bar. Since 1984 we have been grilling, frying and sizzling up the best seafood dishes on the Alabama Gulf Coast.
Sitting in the heart of Orange Beach, Doc’s Seafood Shack offers a gorgeous view of the bay along with excellent food and great service.
 
If you’re in a hurry, browse our seafood menu online and prepare your order ahead of time. Why wait when your seafood order can already be sitting there ready for pickup. You can choose from broiled seafood dishes, grilled, sauteed, fried, and blackened. Just tell us how you prefer it and we’ll make it happen! We offer shrimp, fish, crab, oysters, wings, seafood gumbo, royal red shrimp and much much more.
With so many sides and ways to prepare your food, you cannot stop at just one dish. We have so many options. Do not limit yourself to one favorite flavor. Once you try our delicious food you will return time and again. After all, there are so many dishes to try! And don’t stop there. We have refreshing drinks to compliment any meal. Grab a famous Bushwacker and make it a night of fun with friends and family.
 
Doc’s was voted one of the Top 10 Best Seafood Shacks in the United States. We take pride in this honor by showing our friends and neighbors in Orange Beach, why we represent them. Mouthwatering soft shell crab, chilled raw oysters, fried and grilled shrimp, large seafood platters and much more. You’ve voted us the best and we work hard every day to live up to the title of the best seafood shack.
 
Sit on the outside patio and enjoy the sunset. Share a large platter with the person closest to you or enjoy a little of everything passing the plates around the table with lots of people. No friend or family member will say no to a meal at Doc’s.
Can’t get out to join us? We can bring it to you. Yes, we offer delicious seafood delivery to your door. Call us or visit our website for platter options and information. We look forward to serving you!
